answer: Locks are recorded in spiral, expire in zephyr, and comet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 39 aliases therefore needs 48 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3319 identities would post 2688 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
